name: Asamiya Misuzu
source:
She talks like a Yankee because she acts like a yankee. She was Takurou's senpai in high school and treated him as an errand boy. She has a strong temperament and can come off as unreasonable.

She took Takurou into a back alley to mug him. She is the first victim of his hyponotism.

[Translated from [url=http://amatures.ohimesama.net/saimin/]Official site[/url]]
